name: restura-ci-tool-cyclonedx
description: Lockfile-pinned CI tool install for the release SBOM (supply-chain epic #1283). Bump the version here and regenerate package-lock.json with: npm install --package-lock-only --engine-strict=false --ignore-scripts. xmlbuilder2 is required for --output-format XML (optional peer of @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-library since cyclonedx-npm 7).
